newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Palestinian leader meets Russian President.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian leader meets Russian President.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat began talks in the Kremlin on Tuesday with Russian President Boris Yeltsin, Interfax news agency said.
The schedule of Arafat's two-day official visit also includes talks with Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov and Gennady Seleznyev, speaker of the lower house of parliament.
Yeltsin greeted Arafat as "a friend of the Russian people" Interfax said.

A Kremlin official said a statement would be released after the meeting, part of a new round of diplomatic initiatives by the Russian president, who was laid low for much of last year with heart problems.
Yeltsin met French President Jacques Chirac earlier this month and is due to travel to Helsinki for a summit with U.S. President Bill Clinton in March.

"Arafat's visit should be viewed in the context of a further deepening of Russian-Palestinian political cooperation aimed at advancing the peace process in the Middle East," Itar-Tass news agency said, quoting a Russian Foreign Ministry official.
Russia has been a joint-sponsor, with the United States, of the Middle East peace process. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is expected in Moscow in March.
